text:
mira: heads up — publish CI blocked: regen diff flagged a "breaking" API change in TS SDK but it's just an enum value doc swap in OpenAPI
ci-bot: publish-gate: api-diff detected (PR #8010) - classified as BREAKING by diff-classifier, artifacts: https://ci.internal/diffs/8010
dan: this is noise. the runtime enum values are identical; only the OpenAPI enum descriptions changed (sorting diff from generator reflow)
kevin: quick fix options: 1) add a diff sanitizer that strips description/summary before comparing, 2) teach the classifier to ignore enum-description-only edits, 3) revert the generator tweak that caused the reflow
mira: sampleapp-ts tests are failing because the publish is blocked for org installs. need a fast unblock path
kevin: I pushed a tiny sanitizer in tools/diff-sanitize that removes description/summary for diffing only. local run shows classifier returns NON_BREAKING
ci-bot: update: artifact for branch/kevin/diff-sanitize uploaded; classifier re-run -> NON_BREAKING
release-bot: publish-gate: current policy = auto-fail on BREAKING-classified diffs. creating TICKET-4410 to add "sanitizer" pipeline step and a manual-unblock flow in the console
dan: long-term we should add an integration test that mutates only docs and asserts no publish-block. also improve diff UI to show "docs-only" badge
mira: plan: kevin -> open PR for sanitizer + test, dan -> add UI badge proposal, mira -> follow up with release docs entry. if CI still blocks we'll revert generator change as emergency\e: assigning: @kevin on PR, @dan on UI, @mira on release playbook. keeping this thread as coordination. :thumbsup:
